key_facts: Gold packets are agent-written by default with _reviewed_by recorded (docs/evaluation.md)
Scorer alias map is extended automatically when canonical forms differ from gold names (docs/evaluation.md)
Review packets every review_days verify one node against its sources (docs/evaluation.md)
growmos doctor implements the ten-item readiness checklist (README.md)
summary: The evaluation harness keeps the graph honest without a human: growmos next hands out gold-set packets until gold_min files exist and a review packet every review_days; growmos eval scores raw and resolved entities and relation pairs against the gold set and auto-extends the scorer alias map; growmos doctor prints the playbook's ten-item readiness checklist and growmos sample supports a human pass.
